event.data_license_status: USFS Research Data Archive says the data may be used without additional permissions or fees; cite Short (2026), DOI 10.2737/RDS-2013-0009.7. Check licenses separately for any joined raster or perimeter products.

discovery_time.precision: reported calendar date and HHMM; source timezone is not assigned by this adapter

location_wgs84.accuracy_note: Point geometry requested from the current USFS service in EPSG:4326. The publication's stated minimum location precision is a PLSS section (one-square-mile grid); event-specific accuracy is not provided here.

fire_behavior.weather_mapping_note: Candidate only; FPA-FOD point is an incident reference point, not a verified ignition; it is used as a provisional seed location. Weather is missing.

grid.resolution_note: Nominal 30 m increment following pinned SimFire's fixed degrees-per-cell conversion; east-west ground distance varies by latitude.

fuel.units_and_mapping: Need a pre-event fuel layer; document native classes, vintage and SimFire conversion.

terrain.units_and_mapping: Need an elevation raster aligned to the fixed grid; document units, resampling and NoData handling.

weather.units_and_mapping: Need event-date weather and explicit timezone/unit conversion into SimFire wind and moisture.

limitations: Candidate record only: fuel, terrain and historical weather files have not been obtained or validated.
The source coordinate's event-specific accuracy is unknown; do not treat it as a 30-m GPS ignition.
The reported final fire size reflects actual response and reporting; it is context only, not a no-action target.
Discovery HHMM is kept without an assumed timezone until the source field definition is checked.
Final area was converted from 963309 acres using 1 acre = 0.40468564224 hectares.

references.notes: FPA-FOD MTBS_ID=CA3987612137920210714 is a perimeter-join hint only; the perimeter has not been retrieved. FPA final size is not an untreated-fire target or agent reward.
